dispatch: Student-facing summaries of the same three complete notebook prompts; no additional workflow or schema.

shared.handoff: Give your AI the materials. It should check the content and deliver the finished notebook ZIP containing JSON and required actual images for Premed OS.
shared.recordings: Use recordings only if your chosen AI can actually inspect them; otherwise supply a readable transcript.
shared.largePacket: Work through big packets in smaller batches. Save what was covered and the source details, then ask your AI for the final study guide. Premed OS does not combine separate batches.
shared.storage: Keep the complete downloaded ZIP or folder. The 8 MiB input limit does not guarantee a save; available local storage can run out sooner.

review.label: Review class material
review.bestFor: Review a lecture or lesson, catch up, preview, or understand a confusing topic.
review.minimumBring: Readable material for the topic you want help with.
review.idealBring: The lecture itself plus slides, notes and related readings; objectives if available. A transcript or supported recording can help. These are options, not an all-required list.
review.youWillReceive: A guide that explains the ideas, a Mastery Map of what to explain and do, useful practice with answers and reasoning, and what is covered or missing.
review.limits: Thin or unreadable material limits the result. Add a readable source or narrow the lesson scope.

assessment.label: Prepare for an assessment
assessment.bestFor: Study for a quiz or exam covering one or more lessons.
assessment.minimumBring: The scope or your named study request, plus readable material for the topics you want to prepare.
assessment.idealBring: The review sheet, known format, and relevant lectures, readings and notes across the required lessons.
assessment.youWillReceive: Explanations of the required topics, practice for the relevant skills, worked answers, and a clear list of missing material.
assessment.limits: Week 3 alone cannot cover Weeks 1–6. Keep missing lessons visible; save progress after each evidence batch and ask your AI for the final study guide.

assignment.label: Work on an assignment
assignment.bestFor: Get help with the task at the stage you choose.
assignment.minimumBring: The task, your requested help stage and the sources needed for it; include your draft or data when needed.
assignment.idealBring: The prompt, rubric, required sources or methods, and your work so far.
assignment.youWillReceive: The hint, explanation, plan or feedback you asked for, with concrete next steps and a check against your task requirements.
assignment.limits: A hint stays a hint. Missing rubric details, drafts or data stay unknown; split a large task into named stages.
